title: Regression Fixture
description: A regression fixture that records an originally-broken-then-fixed bug, the test that proves the fix, and the implementation files the fix touched. The orchestrator's regression falsifier (planned for v8) consumes these to verify a candidate patch does not re-introduce a known bug. Schema lands in v7 so contributors know the data contract; the consumer is not yet implemented.

ruleId.description: kebab-case fixture identifier; convention is to mirror the bug's short name or issue id.

originalBugCommit.description: 40-character lowercase hex SHA of the commit that introduced (or last exhibited) the bug, before the fix.

testFilePath.description: Repo-relative path to the test that proves the bug is fixed. Must not be absolute and must not contain '..' segments.

affectedFiles.description: Repo-relative paths of implementation files the fix touched. Used by the regression falsifier to scope re-validation when a candidate patch overlaps these files.

message.description: Human-readable description of the bug; surfaces in regression-falsifier findings.
